下午四点，刘济民和朱霖准备离开，临走时，王愿坚和谢铁骊两个人都告诉刘济民，有剧本创作问题，可以随时去找他们沟通。
刘济民和朱霖下了楼，朱霖抬头看了眼刘济民的背影，抬腿跟上说道：“济民同学，你可真厉害，刚才听他们的问题，我心里为你捏了把汗。没想到，你才思如此敏捷，回答的精彩又流利。”
朱霖狂吹彩虹屁，刘济民淡淡一笑，自信从容，浑身散发着逼味。
这种味道，男女皆斩！
他们并没有立即出燕影厂，刘济民提出好不容易来一趟，参观一下厂子。
“这里让我想起了文工团的日子。”朱霖望着远处几个说笑的女演员，几人刘济民都不认识，看来都是消失在电影长河里的无名之辈。
燕影厂的人经过两人身旁，都忍不住多看他们两眼，等走远后，便捂着嘴巴跟旁边的人轻声嘀咕起来，跟村门口的大妈似的。
朱霖悄悄扭头看了一眼，紧张地说道：“他们看咱们的眼神怎么怪怪的？”
“不用搭理他们，他们可能是以为咱们两个是新来的演员。”刘济民一脸无所谓地说道。
燕影厂的竞争很大，角色就那么多，来了就是竞争对手。
都说文人相轻，演员相轻的更厉害，恨不得全天下只有自己一人出名儿。
朱霖低头看了一下自己，反问道：“像吗？”
“怎么不像？你看我体型修长，棱角分明，吐字清晰，我说自己是文艺兵，谁敢信我是卫生员？”
“哦~啊？”朱霖赶紧点头：“对的对的。”
心里涌起了一丝失望，说了半天，他是在说自己啊！
刘济民看她这样，身子往左边移了半步，肩膀若有若无地碰在一起：“再看你，漂亮气质好，王主任这个文艺战线的老油条，第一眼都把你当成燕影厂的演员了。”
朱霖听罢，笑容取代了郁闷，抬头正好对上了刘济民的目光，眼睛中闪过一丝慌乱，触电般往旁边移了半步，拉开了两人的距离。
“谢谢！谢谢！”
刘济民嘿嘿一笑，继续往前走去，朱霖的脸红到了耳根，生气似地跺了跺脚，又快步跟上。

At four o'clock in the afternoon, Liu Jimin and Zhu Lin were preparing to leave. Before leaving, Wang Yuanjian and Xie Tieli both told Liu Jimin that they could talk to them at any time if they had any script writing issues.
Liu Jimin and Zhu Lin went downstairs. Zhu Lin raised his head and glanced at Liu Jimin's back, raised his leg to follow and said, "Classmate Jimin, you are so awesome. When I heard their questions just now, I felt a little sweat for you. I didn't expect that you are so quick in thinking and your answers are wonderful and fluent."
Zhu Lin blew a rainbow fart wildly, and Liu Jimin smiled lightly, confident and calm, exuding a bit of sex.
This kind of smell will kill both men and women!
They did not leave Yanying Factory immediately. Liu Jimin proposed to come and visit the factory.
"This place reminds me of my days in the art troupe." Zhu Lin looked at a few joking actresses in the distance. Liu Jimin didn't recognize any of them. They seemed to be unknown people who had disappeared into the river of movies.
When people from Yanying Factory passed by the two of them, they couldn't help but look at them twice. After they were far away, they covered their mouths and whispered softly to the people next to them, just like the aunt at the village gate.
Zhu Lin turned around quietly and said nervously, "Why do they look at us so weirdly?"
"Don't pay attention to them, they probably think we two are new actors." Liu Jimin said indifferently.
The competition at Yan Film Studio is huge, there are only so many roles, and you will be a competitor when you come.
It is said that literary men despise each other, and actors despise each other even more. I wish I could be the only one famous in the world.
Zhu Lin looked down at himself and asked, "Does it look like it?"
"Why don't I look the same? Look at me, I have a slender figure, sharp edges, and clear articulation. I say I am an artist, but who dares to believe that I am a health worker?"
"Oh~ ah?" Zhu Lin nodded quickly: "Yes, that's right."
There was a hint of disappointment in my heart. After talking for a long time, he was talking about himself!
Seeing her like this, Liu Jimin moved half a step to the left, and their shoulders touched each other vaguely: "Looking at you again, you are beautiful and have a good temperament. Director Wang, a veteran in the literary and artistic front, at first glance, he thought you were an actor from Yanying Studio."
After hearing this, Zhu Lin's smile replaced his depression. He raised his head and met Liu Jimin's gaze. A trace of panic flashed in his eyes. He moved half a step to the side like an electric shock, widening the distance between the two.
"Thank you! Thank you!"
Liu Jimin chuckled and continued to walk forward. Zhu Lin's face turned red to his ears, he stamped his feet angrily, and quickly followed.
